conbody.p: During the process of negotiation, you may find a section of text that you would like to mark as smart. Mark document content as a clause when:

ul.li: You are with a third party offline agreement created or imported into the agreement record that contains language which should be tagged as clauses.
An external party adds language to the agreement document that constitutes a clause.

conbody.p: By marking this text as a clause in your agreement document, the text adopts the properties of the marked clause. You can even choose to replace text in the agreement with text from a pre-existing clause in your Playbook. When the agreement document is checked in and reconciled to the agreement record, information on marked clauses is added to the Agreement Clauses related list.
Clauses can only be smart in the context of single generated or offline Apttus agreement document.
